title: Durability benchmark: legacy versus FeltDB under crashes and contention (scripted)
summary: 480 records over normal, restart, ambiguous crash and contention scenarios with a scripted model, before and after fixes P1-P3.

results.contention_concurrent_start: B 20/20 with 0 false successes; A 0/20 with 40 false successes
results.restart: no gain in verified completion; B adds 60-120 s of modelled lease wait plus an operator step
results.ambiguous_unobservable_notify: both arms 0/20 with 20 duplicates each: the duplicate is deferred, not prevented

after_fixes.P2: dedup task, ambiguous case 20/20 with 20 dedup-prevented
after_fixes.P3: ambiguous notify 0/20 -> 20/20, lease wait 120 s -> 60 s

results.finding: FeltDB durability alone did not guarantee crash recovery (no gain after a crash; duplicates deferred) until reconciliation, keys and settlement were added

limitations: Synthetic world; do not infer real-model effectiveness
the operator stand-in is always correct
comparability: In-process crashes of a synthetic world; the bake-off tests the real CLI under SIGKILL at five boundaries.
